_comment: Source of truth for profile→leaves mapping. Read by flake.nix at eval time. Keys must stay stable — they are the public profile names referenced by toolsets/presets in flake.nix and build.json. To rename a profile, update this file + flake.nix toolsets + build.json presets in lockstep.
_comment_split-2026-06-19: dev-languages/build-debug/containers-cloud were SPLIT for the dev/user store split (Design B): the heavy dev leaves moved to the `dev-space` group (built into the p5 chroot store, reached via `dev`). dev-languages keeps only node+python (kept at login); build-debug keeps only git-extras; containers-cloud keeps the docker/podman CLI + waydroid runtime + secrets. The rust toolchain (rust-cargo-deps.nix userModule) also moved to dev (removed from flake.nix userModules). Plan: 0_tasks/PLAN_dev-store-split.md.
_comment_data-science: Heavy data-science leaves (python-numerics/ml, jupyter, stats-r, scientific, scraping, databases-cli, api-clients) REMOVED 2026-06-18 to reclaim ~GB of pool — they pulled scipy/sklearn/R/jupyter closures the desktop didn't need (data work runs in cloud/CI). The AI CLIs stay: they are the daily driver, not the ds stack. The profile key is retained (referenced by flake.nix toolsets + build.json) and now carries only the AI CLIs; rename in lockstep across all three if ever desired.
_comment_dev-space: DEV USERSPACE (Design B, 2026-06-18). NOT in any toolset/preset — harvested by flake.nix `devProfile` (a buildEnv) and realised into the p5 chroot store (bc_flakes_dev-store engine), reachable only inside the `dev` bwrap shell. The SAME leaf .nix files are REMOVED from the pool groups (dev-languages/build-debug/containers-cloud below) so the pool keeps only userspace tools. Boundary: dev = compilers/runtimes (minus node/python, kept at login) + all build-tools + cloud-CLIs (k8s/iac/cloud-clis/ci-cd/observability) + android-emulator. Userspace keeps node/python, docker-CLI, waydroid, secrets. Plan: 0_tasks/PLAN_dev-store-split.md.
